items.reason: At eight months past your last isotretinoin dose, this 10% glycolic toner is a reasonable way to smooth the look of uneven texture.
Glycolic acid makes skin more sun-sensitive, so a daily mineral SPF 50 goes with it.
A simple ceramide moisturizer helps keep skin comfortable while it adjusts to a new exfoliating step.

response.routine_note: Start the toner at night 2 times a week after cleansing, follow with the moisturizer, and wear the SPF every morning; do a small patch test first and pause if skin feels stinging or tight. If your prescriber gave you a different waiting period after isotretinoin, follow their advice before starting.
